item.title: Nightshade: Make images unsuitable for model training
Was it a billion dollar mistake?
item.description:
📝 TL;DR null pointer dereferences are empirically the easiest class of invalid memory addresses to catch at runtime, and are the least common kind of invalid memory addresses that happen in memory unsafe languages. However another way to think about null is that it is just one of many invalid memory addresses. Meaning that null is just a kind of sentinel value for memory addresses.
🔗 Read more: https://www.gingerbill.org/article/2026/01/02/was-it-really-a-billion-dollar-mistake/

item.description:
